text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Are you free after school today? I need a reference book, so come shopping with me. I'll buy you a matching eraser as thanks! See you at the school gate! If you're late, I'm going to kill you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんた
今日の放課後ヒマ？　
参考書欲しいから、
買い物付き合ってよ。
お礼はそうね、
お揃いの消しゴムでも買ってやるわ！
じゃ、
校門前で待ってるからね！　
遅れたらぶっ殺すわよ！
